data.title: Floods affect 6,870 people in three provinces
data.description: Flooding remained in Kanchanaburi, Ratchaburi and Satun provinces, affecting 3,128 families or 6,870 people in 86 villages on Wednesday morning, according to the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation.

data.title: FDA warns of online pet scam
data.description: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has warned consumers against buying animal medicines from a Facebook page accused of taking payments without delivering products.

data.title: World Bank offers $3.5m for canal
data.description: The government is preparing to accept a grant worth over 115 million baht from the World Bank to support preparations for a 165-billion-baht flood diversion canal project aimed at reducing flood risks in the lower Chao Phraya basin.

data.title: Govt backs new tools for farmers
data.description: The government is ready to support innovation that adds value to agricultural products and helps farmers reach global markets, according to Kosol Pattama, adviser to the Minister attached to the Prime Minister's Office.

data.title: Seaplane plan set to take off
data.description: Deputy Transport Minister Phattrapong Phattraprasit is accelerating plans to introduce seaplane services in the Andaman region to boost tourism and the local economy while ensuring aviation safety and protecting the environment.

data.title: EC ends mayor's poll rights
data.description: The Election Commission (EC) has moved to revoke the electoral rights of Sila town mayor Phairat Thaweewan and 24 other individuals over alleged violations of election laws.

data.title: Flood victims in Phuket to get payouts
data.description: Residents whose homes were damaged by flash floods and landslides in Phuket can qualify for disaster insurance compensation even if flooding lasted less than seven days, Deputy Interior Minister Worasit Liangprasit said.

data.title: Cop raids smash mule account ring
data.description: Police have arrested 11 suspects in a nationwide crackdown on a transnational network accused of creating and selling corporate mule accounts to scam gangs, money launderers and online gambling operators.

data.title: Pair held over illegal stroke-risk scans
data.description: Two people have been arrested for allegedly providing unlicensed medical services, including ultrasound examinations to assess stroke risk, at a restaurant in Bangkok's Bang Na district, charging 900 baht per customer.

data.title: Ties with China to boost green industry, low-carbon projects
data.description: Thailand and China have tightened cooperation on sustainable industrial development after the cabinet approved two projects worth a combined US$375,900 (12.7 million baht) under the Mekong-Lancang Cooperation Special Fund (MLCSF). The goal is to advance green industry, recycling technology, and low-carbon economic development.

data.title: Houthi attacks 'may imperil Thai Hajj pilgrims', says FM
data.description: Foreign Affairs Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow said Thailand is closely monitoring the escalating situation in the Middle East, expressing concern for Thai citizens performing the Hajj pilgrimage in Saudi Arabia amid fears the conflict may spread.

data.title: Rangsiman urges DSI to pursue case against Shuffle
data.description: People's Party list MP Rangsiman Rome has urged the Department of Special Investigation (DSI) to pursue a criminal case against those behind online gambling website Shuffle, saying there is sufficient evidence to proceed.

data.title: Cabinet approves cheaper fuel prices for 3 months
data.description: The cabinet has approved a three-month reduction in excise taxes on E20 gasohol and B20 biodiesel to help farmers, transport operators, and consumers while boosting demand for agricultural products used in biofuel production, Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said on Tuesday.

data.title: Army says trail resort lacks land-use permit
data.description: A trail-running venue and resort in Nakhon Nayok linked to Athip "God" Anantawan, husband of former beauty queen and charity founder Panadda "Bum" Wongphudee, had no military permission to use the land, the army said on Tuesday.

data.title: Censure debate 'unlikely before Dec': PM
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul does not expect the opposition's no-confidence debate to take place before early December, saying ministers have packed schedules in November and cannot postpone official engagements.

data.title: Health officials track risks from suspected waste leak
data.description: The Public Health Ministry's Department of Disease Control opened an emergency operations centre to monitor health risks after the floods caused a probable leakage from an industrial waste landfill in Prachin Buri province.

data.title: Anutin signals lawsuit for MP's 'tea money' post
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul on Tuesday signalled he could sue People's Party MP Rukchanok Srinork for sharing a Facebook post showing a fake slip for a 7-million-baht "tea money" transfer.

data.title: B35 billion seized from Mauerberger network
data.description: Thai authorities have seized and frozen assets worth 35.8 billion baht in their ongoing investigation into an alleged international money-laundering network linked to South African businessman Benjamin Mauerberger and Cambodia-born entrepreneur Yim Leak.

data.title: Minister defends B200m promotion budget for plant expo
data.description: Deputy Agriculture and Cooperatives Minister Watcharaphon Khaokham has defended a request for more than 200 million baht in additional publicity funding for the Udon Thani International Horticultural Expo 2026, citing economic and social benefits.

data.title: Thai, Vietnamese media press for copyright protection
data.description: Thai and Vietnamese media organisations are pushing for stronger copyright protection and fairer revenue-sharing from global technology platforms such as Google and Meta as digital trends erode news publishers’ traffic and income.
